Data Engineer
Acme Data - Chicago, IL

Acme Data is hiring a Data Engineer to join our Chicago team. This role is hybrid: three days a week in our West Loop office.

What you'll do
- Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL.
- Own our dbt models and Airflow DAGs end to end.
- Partner with analytics on data contracts and quality checks.

What we're looking for
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience building production data pipelines.
- Strong SQL and Python; experience with Snowflake or BigQuery.

Compensation
The base salary range for this role is $145,000 – $175,000, plus equity and benefits.

Acme Data is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
